items.rationale: Cozonac is a concrete, broadly recognizable sweet bread with a dominant culinary sense and easy-band salience .9737 (C1/C2/C5/C6). DEX, public-radio tradition coverage and current national reporting independently support durable familiarity (A1/A2/A4). All24 incoming associations were inspected: recognizable flour, walnut, dessert, other pastries and holiday meals supply several approaches (C3). Actual flour/walnut rank2, dessert5, cacao16 and yeast28 repair the prior nut/flour blockers (C4). Butter remains cold and dough/raisins/holiday words unresolved; those limitations are material backlog, but no longer defeat the defining flour/nut and sweet-bread routes. No generic regional identity or adult-dependent mechanic is used; no existing Contexto row duplicates this target (A3/A5/A6/A7). Recommend promote this bound round, without claiming complete ingredient coverage or human enjoyment.

Pasca is a concrete recognizable Easter cheese bake; the culinary sense dominates ordinary use despite surnames and regional homographs (C1/C2/C5). The normal band is conservative, not an attempt to hide obscurity; salience .72 clears C6. DEX, AGERPRES and public radio independently document cheese, egg, dough and Easter use (A1/A2/A4). All five direct incoming neighbors are recognizable: Cozonac, Easter meal, red eggs, cheese and dessert (C3). Actual cheese5/desert3/flour9 are hot and egg16/milk34 warm, providing distinct dairy and pastry approaches (C4). Standalone Paste and raisins remain unresolved; the round must be judged on the demonstrated food paths, not presumed holiday-input coverage. Exact and accentless answers and the reviewed cheese-pastry phrase win. No generic region, adult framing or existing-target duplication (A3/A5/A6/A7). Promote with the documented missing vocabulary retained as backlog.

Mustar is a spontaneously nameable common condiment and meets easy recognition; salience .8317 clears C6 (C1/C2). Its plant/seed sense is real, but the prepared food is dominant in everyday unqualified culinary use, so this is not a target requiring botanical disambiguation (C5). DEX and independent Romanian public-radio and national-media serving coverage support that judgment (A1/A2/A4). All eight direct neighbors were inspected; Mici, grill, sauce, condiment and street-food serving paths are recognizable and specific (C3/A7). Actual mici2, sos3, gratar5 and condiment7 are hot, with ketchup15/salt21 warm (C4). Missing seeds and cold oil do not erase the core condiment and serving routes. The description is a colloquial common-serving claim, not a requirement that every barbecue use mustard (A3). No duplicate target or editorial hold trigger (A5/A6). Promote; do not infer complete botanical or preparation vocabulary.

Mujdei has one dominant garlic-sauce meaning, is broadly familiar and meets easy salience .7993 (C1/C2/C5/C6). DEX and older/current public-radio recipes independently support definition and durable recognition (A1/A2/A4). All eleven direct neighbors were inspected; garlic, sauces, grill, meat and familiar soups form a legible neighborhood (C3). Actual defining usturoi2 and sos3 are hot, gratar7/ciorba10 hot, salt27/water39 warm (C4). Fish is cold and oil/lemon very cold; those are serving or variant gaps, not interchangeable with the defining garlic route. The round does not promise all pairings work equally well. No region-exclusive claim, duplicate target or adult-dependent play (A3/A5/A6/A7). Promote with those limits explicitly retained.

Ciorba de burta is a concrete, recognizable restaurant dish with an unambiguous compound label; normal salience .8739 is ample (C1/C2/C5/C6). DEX defines it by cattle stomach; public radio and current national ordering coverage independently establish its culinary familiarity (A1/A2/A4). Seven direct incoming neighbors are recognizable, although composite dairy, generic meal and venue links are weaker than soup/garlic/dairy paths (C3/A7). The previously cold defining ingredient was an acceptance blocker. V82 now gives burta rank2 hot and nonwinning for exactly this soup; ciorba2, vinegar10, garlic11 and cream19 provide independent approaches (C4). The tested override preserves all472 vocabulary rows, exact answers, repeats, resume and private anchors, and cannot warm adjacent soups. Description mentions long parties but gameplay depends on ordinary food recognition, not alcohol, adult humor or drinking (A5). No existing target duplicate (A6). Promote only with the tested exact-target repair retained; the broader ingredient vocabulary remains incomplete.

Urda is a concrete Romanian whey cheese, recognizable in ordinary dairy and pastry contexts. Normal band fits its less universal production knowledge; salience .4215 clears C6 (C1/C2/C5). DEX, government culinary guidance and AGERPRES food-market coverage support recognition beyond specialist cheesemakers (A1/A2/A4). All six incoming neighbors are recognizable: cheese, milk, placinte, poale-n brau, papanasi and telemea (C3). Cheese2, milk4 and placinte4 are hot, with dessert17/cream20 warm; a player can reason from both dairy and pastry uses (C4). Defining zer and the form urdei remain unresolved, while sheep is very cold; these are acknowledged deficiencies rather than evidence of complete whey vocabulary. Milk is an upstream material association, not a false direct recipe definition (A3/A7). No adult framing, duplicate target or regional-exclusivity claim (A5/A6). Promote at normal with those gaps explicitly documented.

Friptura is a concrete ordinary meat dish, not an abstract category, with one dominant food sense and strong easy-band familiarity/salience .8598 (C1/C2/C5/C6). DEX and durable public-radio recipe usage independently support definition and recognition (A1/A2/A4). All seven incoming neighbors are familiar and legible: meat, grill, salt, garlic sauce, pickles, bread and festive meals (C3). Gratar2, carne3 and sare4 are hot; garlic25, bread41 and vegetables45 warm (C4). Oven and named pork-roast subtype are unresolved; pan and oil cold. Those deficient preparation routes are real, but the main ingredient and one canonical cooking method independently guide the player; easy does not claim every utensil works. No region-exclusive, adult-dependent or duplicate target mechanism (A3/A5/A6/A7). Promote with the oven/pan/subtype gaps retained, not relabeled as correct feedback.

Bulz is a concrete stuffed-polenta dish, recognizable beyond a specialist audience through Romanian shepherd-food culture. Normal band/salience .4785 suit its narrower familiarity (C1/C2/C6). DEX and independent public-radio recipes plus national-media food coverage support the culinary sense despite general lump/technical/place homographs; the familiar prepared-food reading supplies a nameable target (C5/A1/A2/A4). All eight incoming neighbors were inspected. Polenta, cheese, corn, telemea, burduf cheese and sour-cream dairy provide legible specific routes; the Carpathian link is broad context, not regional exclusivity (C3/A7). Actual mamaliga2, branza3 and burduf6 are hot; milk18/cream24 warm (C4). Malai and some plural/case forms remain unknown, while canonical/accentless answer and bulzul win. These omissions remain backlog, not new synonym claims. No adult framing or existing target duplication (A3/A5/A6). Promote at normal with its documented sense and vocabulary limits.
